2	
3	This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository.
4	
5	## Commands
6	
7	### Building and Testing
8	
9	- `npm run build` - Compile TypeScript to JavaScript in dist/
10	- `npm run test` - Run Jest tests (65 tests covering all functionality)
11	- `npm run lint` - Run ESLint on TypeScript files
12	- `npm run lint:fix` - Run ESLint with auto-fix
13	- `npm run format` - Format code with Prettier
14	- `npm run format:check` - Check code formatting
15	
16	### Single Test Execution
17	
18	Use Jest's pattern matching: `npm test -- --testNamePattern="<test name>"` or `npm test <test-file-path>`
19	
20	## Architecture Overview
21	
22	This is a TypeScript SDK for MLflow Tracing that provides LLM observability. It's designed as a TypeScript port of the Python MLflow tracing implementation, maintaining API compatibility while leveraging OpenTelemetry for the underlying tracing infrastructure.
23	
24	## Core Architecture
25	
26	### Data Flow and Backend Communication
27	
28	```
29	User Code → MLflow APIs → OpenTelemetry → Span Processor → Exporter → Backend
30	    ↓            ↓              ↓              ↓           ↓          ↓
31	withSpan()   LiveSpan    OTel Span    MlflowProcessor  MlflowClient  REST API
32	```
33	
34	### Initialization Flow
35	
36	1. User calls `configure({ tracking_uri, experiment_id })`
37	2. SDK reads Databricks credentials from `~/.databrickscfg`
38	3. OpenTelemetry tracer provider is initialized with MLflow processors
39	4. MLflow span processor and exporter are attached to OTel pipeline
40	
41	### Span Lifecycle
42	
43	1. **Creation**: User calls `withSpan()` or `startSpan()`
44	2. **OTel Integration**: Creates OpenTelemetry span for context propagation
45	3. **MLflow Wrapping**: Wraps OTel span in `LiveSpan` with MLflow metadata
46	4. **Registration**: Registers span with `InMemoryTraceManager`
47	5. **Execution**: User code runs within span context
48	6. **Completion**: Span ends, triggers export pipeline
49	7. **Export**: Only root spans trigger full trace export to backend
50	
51	### Backend Communication Protocol
52	
53	The SDK communicates with MLflow backends through REST APIs:
54	
55	**Trace Lifecycle**:
56	
57	- `POST /api/2.0/mlflow/traces` - Start new trace (creates TraceInfo)
58	- `PUT /api/2.0/mlflow/traces/{trace_id}` - End trace (uploads complete trace + spans)
59	
60	**Trace Operations**:
61	
62	- `GET /api/2.0/mlflow/traces/{trace_id}` - Retrieve single trace
63	- `POST /api/2.0/mlflow/traces/search` - Search traces with filtering
64	- `POST /api/2.0/mlflow/traces/batch` - Bulk trace upload
65	
66	**Tag Management**:
67	
68	- `POST /api/2.0/mlflow/traces/{trace_id}/tags` - Set trace tag
69	- `DELETE /api/2.0/mlflow/traces/{trace_id}/tags/{key}` - Delete trace tag
70	
71	## Core Components
72	
73	### Configuration System (`src/core/config.ts`)
74	
75	- **Entry Point**: `configure()` must be called before tracing operations
76	- **Authentication**: Supports Databricks URIs (`databricks://profile` or `databricks`)
77	- **Credential Resolution**: Reads from `~/.databrickscfg` automatically
78	- **Validation**: Validates required fields (tracking_uri, experiment_id)
79	
80	### High-Level APIs (`src/core/api.ts`)
81	
82	**`withSpan(options?, callback)`**:
83	
84	- Automatic span lifecycle management
85	- Supports both inline and options-based usage
86	- Handles async/sync callbacks automatically
87	- Sets outputs from return values if not manually set
88	
89	**`startSpan(options)`**:
90	
91	- Manual span creation requiring explicit `end()`
92	- Supports parent span relationships
93	- Returns `LiveSpan` for manipulation
94	
95	### Entity System
96	
97	**Span Hierarchy**:
98	
99	- `ISpan` - Interface for all span types
100	- `Span` - Immutable completed spans (with caching)
101	- `LiveSpan` - Mutable active spans with setters
102	- `NoOpSpan` - Fallback when tracing disabled/fails
103	
104	**Trace Structure**:
105	
106	- `Trace` - Container holding `TraceInfo` + `TraceData`
107	- `TraceInfo` - Metadata (ID, timestamps, state, tags, metadata)
108	- `TraceData` - Collection of spans belonging to trace
109	
110	**Supporting Entities**:
111	
112	- `SpanEvent` - Point-in-time events (exceptions, logs)
113	- `SpanStatus` - Span completion status (OK/ERROR/UNSET)
114	- `TraceLocation` - Backend destination (experiment or inference table)
115	
116	### Serialization System
117	
118	All entities support JSON serialization for API communication:
119	
120	- `toJson()` - Convert entity to API-compatible JSON
121	- `fromJson()` - Reconstruct entity from API JSON response
122	- Round-trip tested to ensure data integrity
123	
124	**Key Serialization Patterns**:
125	
126	- Snake_case JSON fields (matching Python MLflow)
127	- Timestamp conversion (ns ↔ ISO strings)
128	- Duration formatting (ms ↔ "1.5s" format)
129	- Nested object serialization for complex attributes
130	
131	### Trace Management (`src/core/trace_manager.ts`)
132	
133	**InMemoryTraceManager** (Singleton):
134	
135	- Maps OpenTelemetry trace IDs → MLflow trace IDs
136	- Maintains active traces and spans in memory
137	- Thread-safe span registration and retrieval
138	- Provides trace export coordination
139	
140	**Key Operations**:
141	
142	- `registerTrace()` - Start new trace tracking
143	- `registerSpan()` - Add span to trace
144	- `getTrace()` - Retrieve trace context manager
145	- `popTrace()` - Remove and export completed trace
146	
147	### OpenTelemetry Integration (`src/core/provider.ts`)
148	
149	**Span Processing Pipeline**:
150	
151	1. `MlflowSpanProcessor.onStart()` - Creates TraceInfo for root spans
152	2. Span execution with MLflow attribute management
153	3. `MlflowSpanProcessor.onEnd()` - Triggers export for root spans
154	
155	**Context Management**:
156	
157	- Uses OpenTelemetry's context propagation
158	- Parent-child span relationships automatically maintained
159	- Active span tracking for nested operations
160	
161	### Export System (`src/exporters/mlflow.ts`)
162	
163	**MlflowSpanExporter**:
164	
165	- Exports complete traces (not individual spans)
166	- Currently stores in memory for testing
167	- Designed to integrate with MlflowClient for real export
168	
169	**Export Triggers**:
170	
171	- Only root span completion triggers export
172	- Child spans contribute to trace but don't trigger export
173	- Ensures complete traces are exported atomically
174	
175	### MLflow Client (`src/clients/MlflowClient.ts`)
176	
177	**Complete REST API Implementation**:
178	
179	- Authentication via Bearer token from `.databrickscfg`
180	- Full error handling with HTTP status parsing
181	- Type-safe request/response interfaces
182	- Support for all MLflow tracing operations
183	- Configurable HTTP request timeouts (default 30s)
184	
185	**Client Operations**:
186	
187	- Trace lifecycle management
188	- Batch operations for performance
189	- Search and filtering capabilities
190	- Tag management for trace metadata
191	- Health checking for connectivity validation
192	
193	**Timeout Configuration**:
194	
195	- Default timeout: 30 seconds
196	- Environment variable: `MLFLOW_HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` (milliseconds)
197	- Constructor option: `timeoutMs` parameter
198	- Uses AbortController for clean request cancellation
199	
200	**Error Handling**:
201	
202	- HTTP error parsing with meaningful messages
203	- Timeout errors with clear messaging
204	- Graceful fallbacks to prevent user code breakage
205	- Retry logic considerations for production use
206	
207	## Key Design Patterns
208	
209	### OpenTelemetry Foundation
210	
211	- All spans backed by OTel spans for ecosystem compatibility
212	- Context propagation handled by OpenTelemetry
213	- Processor/Exporter pattern for trace lifecycle management
214	
215	### MLflow Compatibility
216	
217	- API signatures match Python MLflow implementation
218	- JSON serialization compatible with MLflow REST API
219	- Entity structure mirrors Python classes
220
